verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no user-facing interface or data store, so in-product AI insights from user data is a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows the chip accelerating third-party AI software (Copilot+, partner apps, OpenVINO, oneDNN). The voice-command and Copilot+ claims describe software running on AI PCs, not a capability the processor ships itself.
